title: 1. Absorb tab
description: Use the Absorb tab to absorb an unbound Essence permanently into your Soul Archive.

title: 2. Essence inventory
description: Select the Essence you received from the Training Area.

title: 3. Essence details
description: Review the Essence here before absorbing it.

title: 4. Absorb
description: Press Absorb to bind the Essence to your character.
